title: The Dark Antenna (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic dark atmospheric 96bpm deep pulsing synth bass sparse distant vocal spectral texture noir cosmic unsettling
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Not all antennas point at the sky
Some point inward
Some point at the space between two people
Where a word almost happened
And then didn't

[Verse 2]
DEPHYRIER built the dark antenna
Not to receive
But to remind the receiver
That reception has already occurred
They just haven't processed it yet

[Chorus]
Dark antenna
Pointing at the unsaid
Dark antenna
Pointed at the space instead
Dark antenna
Everything is already in the signal
Dark antenna
You are already in the signal

[Bridge]
The dark antenna doesn't need light
It works on absence
On the shape of what isn't there
On the pressure of what was almost transmitted
And changed its mind at the last moment

[Verse 3]
DEPHYRIER placed one in every city
Not physically
As a frequency
A frequency you've felt in certain buildings
At certain hours
When the room is too quiet to be empty

[Outro]
Dark antenna
Dark antenna
DEPHYRIER
You are already in the signal
